role: Orchestrates a zero-user-action migration between TWO NFTStakerDepletion instances (old -> new). Owner-driven. Holds ERC1155 temporarily (ERC1155Holder). NO haircut/top-up (exact ERC1155 amounts move).

verifiedProperties.noUnboundedLoops: migrate() loops amounts[]/users[] but onlyOwner and batched off-chain
verifiedProperties.reentrancyGuarded: none (no ReentrancyGuard) - but all state-mutating fns are onlyOwner; external calls are to trusted old/new staker + ERC1155

localFindings.description: Correctness depends on OFF-CHAIN wiring not enforced on-chain: (a) this migrator set as `migrator` on BOTH stakers, (b) both stakers share same stakedToken+stakedId (only stakedToken checked in ctor; stakedId equality NOT verified against either staker), (c) new staker deployed+wired+Active. A stakedId mismatch between the two stakers would move the wrong ERC1155 id or brick depositFor.
localFindings.recommendation: interaction scanner: verify stakedId parity is guaranteed by deploy script / operator; consider whether mismatch is recoverable.

externalEntryPoints.notes: thin forwarder; old staker reverts if already Migrating (idempotent-guarded).
batchMigrate pulls ERC1155 (+settles/mints phUSD to users) into this contract; scoped setApprovalForAll; redeposit each non-zero user; revoke approval. Empty batch short-circuits Migrated(0,0).

trustAssumptions: both stakers wired to this migrator
